parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The first record is a production method in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). Lifting the shared implementation into a common location would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app semantics, or vice versa. The duplication is intentional: the sample app carries its own local copy of `measureMemoryUsage` so it can function as a self-contained demonstration without depending on the `DebugPanel` production package.
